parsed.rationale: The rhythm is irregularly irregular (R-R intervals vary widely on the lead II strip) with no discernible P waves and a fibrillatory baseline, so this is not a normal tracing. The tall V4–V5 voltage with deep V1–V3 S waves is also present, and the mild concave ST elevation in V2–V3 is secondary to that voltage and does not meet STEMI criteria.
